question: For veg whsle data, can you analyze our financial performance over the years 2020 to 2023? I need insights into the average wholesale price, maximum wholesale price, minimum wholesale price, wholesale price difference, total wholesale price, total selling price, average loss rate, total loss, and profit for each category within each year. Round all calculated values to two decimal places.
sql:
WITH wholesale_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category_name,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(w.whsle_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS year,
        ROUND(AVG(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS AVG_WHOLESALE_PRICE,
        ROUND(MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS MAX_WHOLESALE_PRICE,
        ROUND(MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS MIN_WHOLESALE_PRICE,
        ROUND(MAX(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg") - MIN(w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS WHOLESALE_PRICE_DIFFERENCE
    FROM veg_whsle_df w
    JOIN veg_cat c ON w.item_code = c.item_code
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(w.whsle_date AS TIMESTAMP)) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
    GROUP BY c.category_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(w.whsle_date AS TIMESTAMP))
),
txn_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category_name,
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(t.txn_date AS TIMESTAMP)) AS year,
        ROUND(SUM(t."qty_sold(kg)" * w."whsle_px_rmb-kg"), 2) AS TOTAL_WHOLESALE_PRICE,
        ROUND(SUM(t."qty_sold(kg)" * t."unit_selling_px_rmb/kg"), 2) AS TOTAL_SELLING_PRICE,
        ROUND(AVG(l."loss_rate_%"), 2) AS AVG_LOSS_RATE,
        ROUND(SUM(t."qty_sold(kg)" * w."whsle_px_rmb-kg" * l."loss_rate_%" / 100), 2) AS TOTAL_LOSS
    FROM veg_txn_df t
    JOIN veg_cat c ON t.item_code = c.item_code
    LEFT JOIN veg_whsle_df w 
        ON t.item_code = w.item_code 
        AND CAST(t.txn_date AS DATE) = CAST(w.whsle_date AS DATE)
    LEFT JOIN veg_loss_rate_df l ON t.item_code = l.item_code
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(t.txn_date AS TIMESTAMP)) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
    GROUP BY c.category_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(t.txn_date AS TIMESTAMP))
)
SELECT 
    w.AVG_WHOLESALE_PRICE,
    w.MAX_WHOLESALE_PRICE,
    w.MIN_WHOLESALE_PRICE,
    w.WHOLESALE_PRICE_DIFFERENCE,
    t.TOTAL_WHOLESALE_PRICE,
    t.TOTAL_SELLING_PRICE,
    t.AVG_LOSS_RATE,
    t.TOTAL_LOSS
FROM wholesale_metrics w
JOIN txn_metrics t ON w.category_name = t.category_name AND w.year = t.year
ORDER BY t.year, w.category_name
